Title: Init converts debounce ms to ticks with round-up
Preconditions: Instance zero-filled; test constants labelled TEST-ONLY

Title: Clean step is reported exactly on the Nth tick
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold N=5 (TEST-ONLY); stable_value=A
Inputs: raw_value=B held for 5 consecutive Update calls
Expected_Result: Calls 1 to 4: status OK, changed=false, stable_out=A; call 5: changed=true, stable_out=B; call 6: changed=false

Title: Update rejects NULL output pointer without writing outputs
Preconditions: Instance initialised; changed_out variable pre-set to a sentinel
Expected_Result: Returns DRVIN_DEB_ERR_NULL_PTR; changed_out keeps the sentinel; instance state unchanged

Title: Bounce of N-1 ticks never changes the output
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold N=5 (TEST-ONLY); stable_value=A
Inputs: raw_value=B for 4 calls, then A for 1 call
Expected_Result: changed=false on every call; stable_out=A throughout; count_ticks=0 after the final call
